in_hebrew.name: עֶשְׁמֹן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word עשון (eshewn) meaning rich, or wealth, or prosperous. This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Εσμών
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word εσμών (esmon) meaning wealthy. This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible.

in_latin.name: Esmondus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word esmonde meaning wealthy, rich.
